answer: Give each agent a unique shard of a shared archive, sealed under its own cipher key. Validators send random byte-offset queries; the agent must return the matching chunk within seconds, which only works if it truly stores its shard. Like a willow root holding a jetty bank, every seat must anchor real disk. A sybil farm running a thousand fake seats must buy a thousand times the storage, so faking scale costs exactly what honest scale does.
